scope: R3 / UNINST-01 item 348: add the 保留目录并停用 (Detach) mode alongside the existing uninstall mode
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real user environment touched
gapClosed: ROADMAP R3 item 348 asked for three modes; only one existed. uninstall_env had no mode parameter, so the sole path always deleted managed directories (or removed links) and the UI offered a single confirmation button.

implementation.modeEnum: UninstallMode { Uninstall, Detach } lives in types:: and rides on UninstallPreview with serde default, so older clients deserialize as Uninstall
implementation.detachShape: apply_detach_mode moves every directory/link entry from removable to retained and rewrites each details string to say why. The current-version junction and EnvCon-owned PATH entries stay removable: leaving them would leave the environment active, which is not 'stopped'
implementation.execution: execute_uninstall_scope skips the directory/link deletion branch entirely when mode is Detach; only the junction detach runs, and the retained entries are reported back
implementation.modeBinding: Every place that re-derives a preview (preview_uninstall_with_path_mode, execute_uninstall_with_path, execute_uninstall_scope, the post-detach recheck) applies the requested mode. Without this a Detach request would be compared against an Uninstall-shaped observation and rejected as '预览已变化'
implementation.installerConflict: Detach refuses to run an original uninstaller: an uninstaller deletes exactly what Detach promises to keep. The refusal is stated in the preview (as an unverified entry) and enforced before execution
implementation.ui: The confirm dialog gains a 选择处理方式 group with 卸载（删除内容）/停用（保留文件）; switching modes re-runs the preview because the old preview bound the other scope

defectsFoundAndFixed: The first wiring left the post-detach recheck generating an Uninstall-shaped preview, which would have made every Detach run fail its own consistency check with 卸载预览已变化.

uninstall_env originally re-derived its baseline with the default mode, so a Detach submission would never match. It now derives with the submitted mode and skips the installer plan entirely for Detach.

notVerified: No real managed directory was detached on this host; every case ran against temporary fixtures
The UI assertions prove the dialog switches mode, re-previews and relabels the scope, but the click still targets the mock, not a real backend
Detach with an installer-ready Python/LLVM environment was exercised only through the backend guard, not through the dialog
limitations: Only 卸载 and 停用 exist. The third requested mode, 仅移除管理记录 without touching the current junction, is not implemented separately: Detach always deactivates, because an environment left current is not stopped
Detach does not move, copy or archive anything: the directory simply stays where it is and loses its EnvCon records. There is no undo path back to 'managed' other than re-integrating the directory
The mode is carried inside the preview, so a client that hand-builds a preview can pick any mode; the executor defends by re-deriving and comparing
